headlines.title: Gas cost calculator: How much have higher gas prices cost you?
headlines.description: Americans have spent an estimated $40 billion more in gas since the Iran war started. According to an NBC News analysis, drivers who fill up twice a month paid anywhere from $20 to $300 more for gas.

headlines.title: U.S. economy lost 23,000 jobs in July, a sudden reversal for the labor market
headlines.description: The U.S. economy shed 23,000 jobs in July, a sign that the labor market had not stabilized after four months of positive growth.

headlines.title: Outlets Don’t Always Offer the Best Deals: Where to Find Bargains
headlines.description: It’s back-to-school season and outlet stores and malls are in high demand, but are they really delivering the best prices? NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to share shopping strategies to find better deals elsewhere. Tips include checking clearance sections, using browser extensions for coupons and more.

headlines.title: Back-to-School Shopping: What Will Cost More and How to Save
headlines.description: Spending on back-to-school shopping is expected to hit a record high in 2026 but there are still plenty of ways to save. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with what will cost more this year, where to find some of the best deals and discounts, and more.

headlines.title: Smarter Grocery and Drugstore Shopping: Tips for Saving Big
headlines.description: From buying in bulk to scrutinizing buzzwords on product packaging, TODAY contributor and NewBeauty editor at large, Sarah Eggenberger, shares smart strategies for shopping at the grocery store, pharmacy, and more, that’ll save you big bucks.

headlines.title: Decoding Confusing Money Terms: APY, ETFs, CDs and More
headlines.description: From APYs to ETFs, financial terms can sometimes feel a bit like another language, so NBC’s chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY to break it all down. See her explanations everything from rates and yields to retirement accounts and more.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Federal Communications Commission scraps limit on broadcast TV ownership
headlines.description: The Federal Communications Commission voted to eliminate a cap on the share of U.S. television households a single company can reach.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after reports he livestreamed self-harm
headlines.description: The blogger recently returned to his native Miami after living in Las Vegas.

headlines.title: SpaceX hit by surging AI costs as insiders prepare to sell their shares
headlines.description: Capital expenditures related to its xAI unit, which runs the Grok service, hit $15.8 billion, more than double what they were in the first quarter.
